top_signals.title: Ukraine strikes third Yandex data center, disrupting digital services across Russia
top_signals.summary: A third Yandex data center in Russia was hit by Ukrainian drones over the weekend, forcing it to shut down and causing further disruptions to cloud services, payments, deliveries and other online services across the country.

top_signals.summary: Back in July, the U.S. slapped an extra 50% duty on a wide range of Canadian exports, including items like dairy, alcohol and cement, with the Trump administration citing alleged Canadian trade discrimination against various U.S. goods. In response, Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government implemented dollar-for-dollar counter-tariffs targeting U.S. goods such as steel, aluminum, appliances and electronics as the tit-for-tat tariffs and trade war between the two nations escalated. top_signals.title: Ares Fund Offering Halted by Australia’s Credit Crackdown
top_signals.summary: Australia’s corporate regulator temporarily barred asset manager Fidante Partners Ltd. from offering units in a fund it runs with Ares Management Corp., as authorities expand a clampdown on investment products deemed too risky for retail investors.

top_signals.title: Trump's Grid Security Order Could Backfire on America's AI Boom
top_signals.summary: A White House executive order designed to secure the US power grid from Chinese-made equipment is more likely to disrupt battery storage supply chains than the transformers and switchgear it aims to target, according to new Rystad Energy analysis. Executive Order 14421, signed by President Donald Trump on 26 August 2026, names substation transformers, grid-connected inverters, battery energy storage systems, high-voltage circuit breakers and generation turbines as covered equipment.
